c807a54e09983254a327fb3158a12382.overview: A weary gunfighter attempts to settle down with a homestead family, but a smouldering settler and rancher conflict forces him to act.
c807a54e09983254a327fb3158a12382.tagline: The greatest story of the West ever filmed!

c80902f3b094f0f363cb242bdb491600.overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary about the Clinton for President campaign, focusing on the adventures of spin doctors James Carville and George Stephanopoulos.
c80902f3b094f0f363cb242bdb491600.tagline: They changed the way campaigns are won.

c819fe377b5bad4681a881ac95bfad17.overview: Aspiring actor Edward undergoes a radical medical procedure to drastically transform his appearance. But his new dream face quickly turns into a nightmare.

c85a77a07642016c04860e45b61e7f35.overview: When a young writer is falsely accused of murdering a famous actress, he escapes custody and joins forces with the daughter of a police constable to prove his innocence.

c86c4d9314ff5bb5689cf480f1329338.overview: It's World War II and there is a severe housing shortage everywhere - especially in Washington, D.C. where Connie Milligan rents an apartment. Believing it to be her patriotic duty, Connie offers to sublet half of her apartment, fully expecting a suitable female tenent. What she gets instead is mischievous, middle-aged Benjamin Dingle. Dingle talks her into subletting to him and then promptly sublets half of his half to young, irreverent Joe Carter - creating a situation tailor-made for comedy and romance.
c86c4d9314ff5bb5689cf480f1329338.tagline: The only picture with a DINGLE!

c8a9451a6a26fe57eef3409c4f0e9e89.overview: Near a gray and unnamed city is the Zone, a place guarded by barbed wire and soldiers, and where the normal laws of physics are victim to frequent anomalies. A stalker guides two men into the Zone, specifically to an area in which deep-seated desires are granted.
c8a9451a6a26fe57eef3409c4f0e9e89.tagline: There's no need to speak. You must only...concentrate and recall all your past life. When a man thinks of the past, he becomes kinder.

c8b09f017c29d8edea77978e509c55c4.overview: A disillusioned college graduate finds himself torn between his older lover and her daughter.
c8b09f017c29d8edea77978e509c55c4.tagline: This is Benjamin. He’s a little worried about his future.

c8b5c510029196b1875b2236f8765d48.overview: Pat Pemberton is a brilliant athlete, except when her domineering fiancé is around. The ladies golf championship is in her reach until she gets flustered by his presence at the final holes. He wants them to get married and forget the whole thing, but she cannot give up on herself that easily. She enlists the help of Mike Conovan, a slightly shady sports promoter. Together they face mobsters, a jealous boxer, and a growing mutual attraction.
c8b5c510029196b1875b2236f8765d48.tagline: Together again - and it's no fib, their funniest hit since "Adam's Rib"

c8e2078d6a98ba25837c3f2ca1a568a9.overview: The accidental mix-up of four identical plaid overnight bags leads to a series of increasingly wild and wacky situations.

c8e34cc0782808186c7868834ff94792.overview: On the planet Ygam, the Draags, extremely technologically and spiritually advanced blue humanoids, consider the tiny Oms, human beings descendants of Terra's inhabitants, as ignorant animals. Those who live in slavery are treated as simple pets and used to entertain Draag children; those who live hidden in the hostile wilderness of the planet are periodically hunted and ruthlessly slaughtered as if they were vermin.
c8e34cc0782808186c7868834ff94792.tagline: A sublime trip to a fine new world!

c8fce5392504fa09bb0b1e449cc84873.overview: The U.S. government recognizes land grants made when the West was under Spanish rule. This inspires James Reavis to forge a chain of historical evidence that makes a foundling girl the Baroness of Arizona. Reavis marries the girl and presses his claim to the entire Arizona territory.
c8fce5392504fa09bb0b1e449cc84873.tagline: The lustiest adventure a man ever lived!
